device.description: 16-bit 4-channel simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC with bipolar inputs (+-10 V / +-5 V) on a single supply, parallel / byte / serial read-out
device.note: ads8584s.pdf (SBAS834A) p.3-5 pin configuration and functions (pins 53-56 and 61-64 are AGND), p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.12 tCONV (7.15), p.13 serial switching characteristics (7.18), p.15 Figure 5 serial read, p.27 oversampling decoding (Table 1), p.32 transfer function (twos complement), p.34-36 pin descriptions, p.41 serial data read (16 SCLKs per channel, 64 for four channels on DOUTA)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: levels of the OS2-OS0 pins (no device registers)

pages: p.3-5 pin configuration and functions (pins 53-56 and 61-64 are AGND), p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.12 tCONV (7.15), p.13 serial switching characteristics (7.18), p.15 Figure 5 serial read, p.27 oversampling decoding (Table 1), p.32 transfer function (twos complement), p.34-36 pin descriptions, p.41 serial data read (16 SCLKs per channel, 64 for four channels on DOUTA)
notModeled: only the serial interface is modeled (PAR/SER/BYTE SEL = 1, DB15/BYTE SEL = 0) with DOUTA alone: 4 results of 16 bits each, channel 1 first (64 SCLKs); the PAR/SER/BYTE SEL and BYTE SEL straps are not read

DOUTB (channels 3-4 first, then 1-2) is never driven; parallel (DB[15:0], one channel per RD falling edge) and parallel byte (DB[7:0], HBEN byte order) interfaces not modeled; the DB pins are never driven
a frame may be split into per-channel CS frames (the channel pointer continues across CS frames); the model restarts at channel 1 at each CS fall (all channels carry the same 0 V code)
FRSTDATA output (high while channel 1 is shifted out) not driven

CONVSTB: a conversion begins after the rising edges of both CONVSTA and CONVSTB (channels 3-4 on CONVSTB); the model starts all channels on CONVSTA rising (tie CONVSTA and CONVSTB together, required in oversampling mode)

OS2-OS0 oversampling ratio only sets the conversion time (BUSY high time); the pins are latched at BUSY falling for the next conversion in the device, read continuously by the model; OS = 111 (invalid) uses the longest time
reads during a conversion return the previous sample in the device (same 0 V code)
STBY / RANGE power-down modes (standby, shutdown), REFSEL, RANGE input range: not modeled
RESET also needed after power-up (the model starts reset); minimum 50 ns pulse
SPI mode: SCLK idles high in Figure 5; MSB driven at CS fall, later bits on SCLK rising, read on SCLK falling: modeled as mode 2
analog inputs, PGA, low-pass filter, reference, acquisition time
conversion times are the datasheet typical BUSY high times (no maximum is given)
variants: Pin-compatible family (ADS8588H Table 7-3): ADS8598H 18-bit 500 kSPS, ADS8598S 18-bit 200 kSPS, ADS8588H 16-bit 500 kSPS, ADS8588S 16-bit 200 kSPS, ADS8586S 16-bit 6 channels, ADS8584S 16-bit 4 channels, ADS8578S 14-bit 8 channels; each has its own datasheet
